# Pinvelto

Internal documentation at /docs. Install the reviewed project revision, build with pnpm --filter pinvelto-extension build, install local packages/server, and configure pinvelto MCP at http://127.0.0.1:3847/mcp.

Guides: /docs/installation, /docs/mcp-setup, /docs/workflows, /docs/workflows/variants, /docs/workflows/sharing, /docs/troubleshooting, /docs/releases, /docs/terms.

Project: https://github.com/luxi78/vibe-annotations
